premise: At sunrise Woodpecker drums good morning just as Owl and Badger are going to bed; he tries to tap quietly, and his soft tap… tap… becomes their lullaby.
inspiration: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse (Aesop), turned: two different clocks share one tree, and the loud one finds a quiet way to be kind.
lesson: The same gift can be given loudly or softly; kindness picks the right one.

en-US.title: Woodpecker Knocks Too Early
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} [excited] Up came the sun, and {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Woodpecker flew to the trunk of the big tree. Time to drum good morning! {woodpecker:live} {sfx:drum} TAP-TAP-TAP! Up on a branch, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Owl's eyes popped open. {owl:face surprised} Hoo? And across the meadow came {badger:enter} Badger, {badger:face sad} yawning. [sighs] Woodpecker, said Badger, we've been up all night. Morning is our bedtime! {woodpecker:face surprised} Oh! said Woodpecker. {woodpecker:tint #FFB6C8} Sorry! He tried again, very, very quietly. {sfx:soft-tap} tap… tap… tap… [softly] {badger:face happy} Hmm, said Badger. That's nice. {badger:live} Badger dug a cosy spot in the grass. Up on his branch, Owl {owl:live hold} gave a great big yawn and fell fast asleep. {badger:face sleeping} [whispers] So Woodpecker kept on drumming, soft and slow. {woodpecker:live} {sfx:soft-tap} tap… tap… tap… {woodpecker:face happy} [happily] TAP-TAP-TAP means good morning. And tap… tap… tap… {woodpecker:hearts} means goodnight.

es-ES.title: Carpintero llama muy temprano
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.7 20s} [excited] Salió el sol, y {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pájaro carpintero voló al tronco del árbol grande. ¡Hora de tocar los buenos días! {woodpecker:live} {sfx:drum} ¡TOC-TOC-TOC! En una rama, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Búho abrió los ojos de par en par. {owl:face surprised} ¿Uuu? Y por el prado llegó {badger:enter} Tejón, {badger:face sad} bostezando. [sighs] Carpintero, dijo Tejón, hemos pasado toda la noche despiertos. ¡La mañana es nuestra hora de dormir! {woodpecker:face surprised} ¡Uy! dijo Carpintero. {woodpecker:tint #FFB6C8} ¡Perdón! Y probó otra vez, muy, muy flojito. {sfx:soft-tap} toc… toc… toc… [softly] {badger:face happy} Mmm, dijo Tejón. Qué bonito. {badger:live} Tejón cavó un hoyito bien cómodo en la hierba. En su rama, Búho {owl:live hold} dio un gran bostezo y se quedó dormido. {badger:face sleeping} [whispers] Y Carpintero siguió tocando, suave y despacito. {woodpecker:live} {sfx:soft-tap} toc… toc… toc… {woodpecker:face happy} [happily] TOC-TOC-TOC quiere decir buenos días. Y toc… toc… toc… {woodpecker:hearts} quiere decir buenas noches.

drum.prompt: a woodpecker drumming fast on a tree trunk, bright morning, realistic field recording

soft-tap.prompt: three slow, very soft taps of a small beak on tree bark, gentle and quiet, realistic
